items.title: Cisco Systems Raises Outlook On Soaring Revenue, Profit
items.summary: The company posted a first-quarter profit of $4.55 billion, driven by high demand in the agentic artificial-intelligence market.

items.title: Cerebras Lifts Outlook as Cloud Revenue Surges in Third Quarter
items.summary: The company now expects core revenue of between $940 million and $960 million for the year on continued demand for its cloud services, even as direct sales of its artificial-intelligence chips fell.

items.title: Existing-Home Sales Fall to Lowest Level Since 2010 as Mortgage Rates Take Their Toll
items.summary: October home sales were the slowest in 16 years according to the National Association of Realtors. High mortgage rates are keeping potential buyers on the sidelines.

items.title: Nebius Lowers Outlook, Addresses Worries Over Financing AI Buildout
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence cloud company lowered its full-year revenue outlook, citing a delay in some third-party capacity.

items.title: Brookfield Earnings Buoyed by Fund Raising, Wealth Solutions Growth
items.summary: Brookfield notched stronger earnings in the third quarter as the investment firm saw strong fundraising in its asset-management operations and growth in wealth solutions.
